question_text: A booking relation contains VisitorID, VisitorName, GuideID, GuideName, Specialism, VisitTime, RouteID, RouteName, Fee. VisitorID determines VisitorName; GuideID determines GuideName and Specialism; RouteID determines RouteName and Fee. Each booking has a unique BookingID and exactly one visitor, guide and route. Construct a 3NF schema, labelling primary and foreign keys.
adaptation_rationale: Supplies explicit functional dependencies and unique booking identifier, resolving source ambiguity about treatment cost and specialties.
solution: VISITOR(VisitorID PK, VisitorName); GUIDE(GuideID PK, GuideName, Specialism); ROUTE(RouteID PK, RouteName, Fee); BOOKING(BookingID PK, VisitorID FK, GuideID FK, RouteID FK, VisitTime).

marking_points.criterion: VISITOR with correct key and attributes.
GUIDE with correct key and attributes.
ROUTE with correct key and attributes.
BOOKING with key, VisitTime and references.
Foreign keys identified; no transitive names/fees retained in BOOKING.

partial_credit_notes: Award independent criteria up to the stated total; accept equivalent technically correct wording/solutions.

verification.technical: Concrete answer reasoned and checked against full syllabus guidance and available source MS.
